summary: H3 model wiring split out from the research card. Created blocked: the licence gate (MPI-451) must land first, and whether the authorization reaches end users in excluded territories is still unconfirmed.

note: Unblocked and started. The engine half is DONE: pinned 0.29.2 -> 0.30.0 (system_dependencies.json + node_lock.json + regenerated python_deps.txt, which moved no package version), app engine upgraded IN PLACE by git checkout rather than the full wipe-and-redownload, and all 167 class_types used by every shipped runtime workflow verified registering on 0.30.0 with zero missing. H3 support landed in 0.30.0 itself (commits 7dd46274 + 57500fc5); 0.30.1/0.30.2 are real tags with NO Comfy-Org portable build, so 0.30.0 was the ceiling. Workflow half done: raw -> API -> runtime via a new generate_h3.py + a minimax_h3_ prefix in registry.py, emitting comfy_workflows/minimax_h3_fl2va.json (64 nodes, 4 H3 branches, injection gate clean). The generator BAKES the authoring bench away - the export carried Input_End_Frame="d", which feeds has_img2 and would have made every run believe an end frame was present. Two-stage needed a node fix, not an app special case: MpiSaveLatent reported no ui payload and MpiLoadLatent only read <output>/latents/, so the app could neither see the stage-1 latent nor have its staged copy found. Fixed in ComfyUi-MpiNodes a6e5d5e (save reports ui.latents like core SaveLatent; load checks engine input/ first, falls back to output/latents/ so the bench flow is unchanged) and proved by a live save->view->stage->load round trip. Licence gate MPI-451 is running in a PARALLEL session and its licences.js already keys on model id minimax-h3, which fixes this ModelDef id; ref2va will be a separate minimax-h3-ref2va. Remaining: dep entries, ModelDef, progressStages (needs a live run to count bars), docs/models/h3/.
